properties.name: clueterra.internal.secret
properties.description: Shared secret expected in the X-Internal-Token header for internal admin endpoints.

properties.name: clueterra.storage.compress-raster-images
properties.description: Whether downloaded raster hint images should be resized and recompressed before storing in MinIO.

properties.description: Maximum stored image width in pixels for raster hint assets.

properties.name: clueterra.storage.jpeg-quality
properties.description: JPEG compression quality used when recompressing opaque raster hint images.
